reads_writes_findings.current_meaning: Reads/writes are free-text lists of data artifacts (InferredValue) per node, scored by _data_recall: a hit if any raw token overlaps OR truth value is a substring of the agent value (any single shared token suffices).
reads_writes_findings.quote_vs_quotation: B evaluator-too-strict: no shared token, 'quote' not substring of 'quotation' -> miss. Documented in wordnet experiment.
reads_writes_findings.sent_quote: GT write artifact never named by stakeholder; agent leaves empty (or 'quotation') -> C modeling + B wording. sq.writes=[sent_quote] is P0-unobtainable.
reads_writes_findings.approval: GT write artifact (ap.writes=[approval]) and read (ap.reads=[quote]) never stated; system=quoting never stated -> P0.
reads_writes_findings.excel_summary: stakeholder states summary as Excel file; agent 'summary of quotation information' matches via 'summary' token -> largely recoverable; empty in runs 02/04 = A genuine miss.
reads_writes_findings.request: stakeholder states 'record the request'; agent often leaves r.writes empty -> A/C.
ambiguity: read/write semantics are only loosely defined (data artifacts as free text); no ontology -> matching relies on raw token overlap
_data_recall is lenient (any single token) while _match_nodes requires >=2 significant tokens (inconsistent thresholds)

matching_responsibility_map.node_matching: evaluation._match_nodes — scenario-local via spec.expressions; >=2 sig tokens or whole-expression substring; greedy by (overlap, bonus); bonus from norm_role/norm_system. Risk: quote/quotation, paraphrases miss; any single-token weak match rejected.
matching_responsibility_map.role_normalization: aliases.norm_role — scenario-global alias table (sales/manager). Risk: first-person 'I (the stakeholder)' not aliased -> miss (B).
matching_responsibility_map.system_normalization: aliases.norm_system — global (crm/quoting/email/excel). Risk: 'quoting system' vs 'quoting' ok; 'CRM' ok.
matching_responsibility_map.reads_writes: evaluation._data_recall — raw token overlap OR substring; lenient single-token threshold. Risk: quote/quotation miss; false positives from single shared token (e.g. customer).
matching_responsibility_map.predicates: evaluation._predicate_ok — _PREDICATE_STOP drops amount/quote/quotation/digits; token overlap or substring over spec.predicate_expressions. Risk: numeric thresholds, 'over 1,000,000' variants.
matching_responsibility_map.necessity: evaluation._necessity_value_ok — substring/token overlap over spec.necessity_expressions; requires asserted (confidence>0).
matching_responsibility_map.primitive_resolution: concepts.resolve_primitive — global generic primitives, returns 'unclassified' if unknown; diagnostic only. Note docstring says 'returns None'.
matching_responsibility_map.evaluation_spec_expressions: scenario.quotation_spec/lab_sample_spec — scenario-local hidden aliases for node/predicate/necessity matching.
matching_responsibility_map.evidence_hygiene: evaluation._evidence_metrics — only checks observation references are real & authentic; does NOT check semantic support.

P0_unfair_or_impossible_contract: approval node ap.system='quoting' is scored pass-critical but the stakeholder never states where approval happens -> unobtainable
sq.reads=[quote] and sq.writes=[sent_quote] scored pass-critical, never stated
A faithful agent recording only known_info fails structural_pass (verified experimentally) -> reward 0 despite correct interviewing
These force the agent to either fabricate (violating policy 'record only what the interviewee states') or fail.
P1_materially_distorts_scoring: quote/quotation evaluator-too-strict (B, 22 cases) masks real agent skill; any run with 'quotation' wording for 'quote' is penalized
actor 'I (the stakeholder)' vs 'sales' not aliased (norm_role first-person gap) -> 10 B cases
lab reads/writes artifact names (accessioned sample, seasoned chamber, conditioned sample, batch approval) are mostly implied not stated -> agent must guess
reward is a hard AND-gate product: any single attribute mismatch zeroes reward -> no partial credit, amplifies P0/P1
P2_architectural_debt: StakeholderFilter is constructed and stored in Scenario but never applied at runtime (dead modeling layer); stakeholder knowledge actually lives in tasks.json known_info, creating two sources of truth that can drift
primitives partially hardcoded in tasks.json reference actions AND computed by concepts.resolve_primitive (duplicated responsibility)
_data_recall (any 1 token) vs _match_nodes (>=2 sig tokens) threshold inconsistency
get_eval_diagnostics only wired for half-duplex (full-duplex path doesn't surface domain metrics)
evaluator_metrics/truth_dag/evaluation_spec_hidden serialized into real-run artifacts (analysis convenience, but spec is 'hidden')
P3_cleanup_or_docs: dead code: value_signals/_VALUE_VARIANTS, quotation_finance_filter, InterviewResult/interview_result, unused primitives (move/notify/reconcile/record/reject/review/update)
stale docs: aliases references semantic.py/ground_truth.py; concepts docstring 'returns None'; version header drift (v3/v4/v5); README says v5
gitignored __pycache__ leftovers of removed modules (ground_truth/data_model/semantic) — harmless but confusing

recommended_next_goal: Make the benchmark contract fair: (1) either surface the currently-unobtainable GT facts (ap.system, ap/sq/me reads, ap/sq writes) in the stakeholder known_info or drop them from the GT / mark them unclassified/optional, and (2) relax the hard AND-gate reward so a single synonym/actor mismatch doesn't zero the score (or fix the quote/quotation + first-person aliasing). Do this as a dedicated follow-up goal with tests; do NOT implement it here.
